prompts.sanctum: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full-width live game background for Infinite Tower — Abyss, a Korean collectible RPG. Create a richly painted dark fantasy environment, no characters and absolutely no text or UI. A colossal black basalt tower interior descends into a cathedral-like abyss; a tall sealed doorway on the RIGHT HALF glows with a restrained thin ember-red fissure, worn ivory carvings and oxidized old bronze embedded in black stone, heavy chains and ash in atmospheric depth. Broken stairways and distant vertical architecture imply impossible height. LEFT THIRD is quiet shadowed charcoal architecture with low detail for readable white DOM headings. Bottom quarter is a broad dark stone terrace suitable behind party portraits. Elegant premium high-end game art, sharp material detail, cinematic scale, predominantly charcoal/stone with bone ivory and muted rust red; no neon, purple, blue, cartoon skulls, logos, lettering, icons, borders, interface controls. Wide landscape 16:9 composition, high resolution. This is a background asset, not a finished UI mockup.
prompts.frame: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: reusable nine-slice game UI panel frame, Infinite Tower — Abyss. Produce ONE centered rectangular frame on a genuinely transparent outer background, straight-on orthographic, approximately 2:1 wide. A very thin weathered black-iron rim inlaid with subtle tarnished bronze, tiny carved bone-ivory geometric corner clasps and restrained ember-red fissures. Deep charcoal softly textured opaque center, empty and perfectly usable for dynamic text. Thin symmetrical corners, straight unobstructed edges suited to nine-slice stretching; decorative content confined to outer 7 percent, keep central 85 percent quiet. Premium painted RPG asset, tactile material and refined silhouette, severe elegant gothic design, not ornate fantasy gold, no wings, skull, portrait, icon, writing, number or baked-in label. The outside silhouette must have real transparent alpha. No checkerboard.
prompts.button: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: one wide nine-slice action button plate for Infinite Tower — Abyss, actual live Korean RPG UI. ONE isolated centered horizontal black iron button, 4:1 ratio, front view. Strong but refined chamfered stone-and-iron silhouette, worn antique-bronze bevel, small carved ivory end-caps, a narrow deep crimson ember seam along the lower edge. Empty dark inner surface with generous text-safe center; only the left and right ends contain ornament, regular straight horizontal edges for nine-slice stretch. Premium hand-painted AAA dark fantasy material, crisp edges, restrained highlights. No text, letter, number, symbol, crest, skull, wings or drop shadow beyond the asset. Genuine transparent outer alpha, no white or checkerboard background.
prompts.seal: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Infinite Tower — Abyss floor-marker and achievement seal with transparent background. ONE centered circular ancient black-stone seal surrounded by a narrow asymmetrical ring of carved bone-ivory and weathered iron segments, tiny restrained ember-red fissures. Monumental but elegant vertical spear-like crown at top and tapering split stone at bottom; roughly square overall with 80 percent blank dark center reserved for dynamic floor numbers. Straight-on orthographic premium hand-painted game inventory/UI asset with real tactile stone and metallic edges. Outer silhouette has genuine transparent alpha. No skulls, wings, humanoids, text, letters, numbers, runes resembling writing or logos. No glows filling the central text area, no scenery, no checkerboard. Consistent charcoal, aged bronze, bone ivory, muted crimson palette.
